prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Draw a giraffe version of the Chinese “大笑奶龙” laughing meme as a square reaction sticker. Make it a plump, butter-yellow baby giraffe with the soft, rounded shape of a squeeze toy. Give it two short brown-tipped horns, floppy ears, and a few big caramel patches down a thick, gently curved neck. The joke is in the enormous belly laugh. Tip its head back just enough that we can still see its face, squeeze its tiny eyes shut into upside-down U’s, bunch its cheeks high, and stretch its mouth open into a huge, goofy grin. Let the dark mouth take up most of the lower face, with a round pink tongue visible at the bottom. Pull its little front hooves up against its potbelly as if it can barely breathe from laughing. Frame it close in a three-quarter view, with the head filling most of the upper half and the horns fully visible. Use simple smooth 3D cartoon forms, soft lighting, and a plain pale background so the expression reads instantly at thumbnail size. No lettering or watermark.
